notes: Every usable attack activity on every weapon Item in the live world and actor inventories is now normalized to Dexterity for to-hit.
World Hygiene performs the universal DEX pass after legacy duplicate-attack cleanup so hidden empty legacy stubs are not accidentally promoted into configured attacks.
The DEX pass covers catalog firearms, melee weapons, unique weapons, and non-catalog weapon Items with real attack activities.
Melee and Unique Weapon catalog migrations now also write DEX directly so future copies inherit the rule before the global hygiene pass.
The canonical 78-gun catalog already enforced DEX and remains unchanged.
Any failed live mutation is retained in the hygiene DEX report instead of being silently ignored.
No damage formulas, ranges, reload rules, manufacturer rules, armor, cyberware, grenades, or Quickhacks changed.
